notes.title: Unlimited Mode
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Long time no see, sorry for long delay.
Today I want to show a new game mode, that is work in progress right now.
The game has main campaign mode with more than 45 handcrafted levels, but I decided that it needs more replay-ability, so I am currently working on on a new endless mode, where you will be able to play infinite amount of levels after you finish main Campaign.

[previewyoutube=ehuQG351cjY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: UPDATED DEMO, PANCAKE WEEK FESTIVAL
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955051/518c64d7deaaa7cd7c306d21bfda0394174c6650.png

Hello everyone, 
In today's post I want to show you new updated Demo of Watch Your Ride.

Some of the changes:
-I modified some of the levels to make learning curve for new player more easier.
-Fixed some bugs, reported on GameJolt.
-I added air control for bicycle.
-Brakes works a lot better now.
-Improved gamepad support.
-Improved overall game performance.

If you haven't tried demo yet, you can get it free on GameJolt:

https://gamejolt.com/games/watch_your_ride/553248

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955051/1cde15eef3cc82e92f41f99a9d6b5a67b55943f4.png

Also we are proud to announce that we are participating in Eastern Europe games event, called Pancake Week Festival :)
You can check their page here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955051/3f83ce68cbe7c9f185f38ad49a65af567a2cea03.png

Also you can follow Watch Your Ride at Steam page (And add it to your Wishlist) to not miss the news.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955051/79c5982841896d439071199f6e70cc9205d0321d.png
